title: Javonte Williams on new contract: Hard work paid off, now I have more to prove

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Javonte Williams on new contract: Hard work paid off, now I have more to prove
sources.description: After running back Javonte Williams went to Dallas on a one-year, $3.5 million contract last year, he gave the Cowboys more than their money's worth, having the best season of his career with 252 carries for 1,201 yards and 11 touchdowns.
